trigger.description: More than 16 distinct successful or reused imported sessions are eligible for explicit proposal review. Only the first 16 are reviewed (or planned in dry run); remaining sessions keep their source import result and explicit follow-up review commands.
setup_commands: # Use a CASS corpus with at least 17 distinct eligible sessions for the selected workspace.

expected_emission.repair_string: Run review.sessions[].retryCommand for deferred committed sessions. Additional deferred IDs are in the original import sessions array; review them explicitly with ee review session <sessionId> --propose using the same --workspace and --database. During a dry run, repeat the import without --dry-run first.
